reply:
Right — the house is the default script, and a coffee shop has no script yet. She’s never done it that way, so neither of you knows what it would be like. That’s probably part of why your mind keeps putting her in the yard: it’s the familiar scene, even if it’s the harder one.

But she didn’t actually ask for the yard. She said your side of town. So the question may be less “how do I get through Friday in the yard” and more “can I answer the message in a way that changes the setting without making it a confrontation?”

If you sent something like “There’s a coffee place near me — want to meet there instead?” what comes up for you?
